title: "Come to the station" — detention or arrest?
officerCan: Ask you to attend, and serve a notice of appearance where the law provides for one instead of arrest.
Arrest without warrant in the circumstances s.35 specifies.
officerCannot: Hold you in custody without either an arrest or a lawful basis, while calling it something else.
Refuse to say whether you are under arrest.

quotableLine.en: May I know — am I under arrest, or am I free to go? If it is a notice, may I have it in writing?
quotableLine.hi: क्या मैं जान सकता हूँ — क्या मुझे गिरफ़्तार किया जा रहा है, या मैं जा सकता हूँ? अगर नोटिस है, तो क्या लिखित में मिल सकता है?
quotableLine.ta: நான் கைது செய்யப்பட்டுள்ளேனா, அல்லது செல்ல முடியுமா? அறிவிப்பு எனில், எழுத்து மூலம் தர முடியுமா?
quotableLine.te: నేను అరెస్టు అయ్యానా, లేక వెళ్లవచ్చా? నోటీసు అయితే, రాతపూర్వకంగా ఇవ్వగలరా?
quotableLine.bn: আমি কি গ্রেপ্তার, নাকি যেতে পারি? যদি নোটিশ হয়, লিখিতভাবে দেবেন কি?
quotableLine.mr: मला अटक झाली आहे का, की मी जाऊ शकतो? नोटीस असल्यास, लेखी मिळेल का?
quotableLine.kn: ನನ್ನನ್ನು ಬಂಧಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆಯೇ, ಅಥವಾ ಹೋಗಬಹುದೇ? ನೋಟಿಸ್ ಆದರೆ, ಲಿಖಿತವಾಗಿ ಕೊಡುವಿರಾ?

documentNow: The exact answer to "am I under arrest", and the time it was asked.

options.label: Ask once, calmly: am I under arrest, or free to go?
options.rationale: The answer determines every right that follows.

options.label: If it is a notice rather than an arrest, ask for it in writing.
options.rationale: A written notice under s.35(3) is the thing you comply with — and complying with it matters later.

options.label: Tell the officer you are informing a family member, and do it.
options.rationale: Ordinary, non-confrontational, and creates a witness to the time and place.
